items.title: Earl Turbinton Interview, 1990-09-01
items.q: >> [INTERVIEWER] Can we get that out there, Brad?

ctx.x: but more like a temple or a place to come and bathe yourself in music and to pray in music. And when we did play in that room, not only were the musicians very telepathic, but many, many times, and as a listener, if you were there, I'm sure you may have experienced the same thing, where sometimes we would be transported to a zone where it felt like the whole room was of one mind and the music was happening right there. Because a great majority of what we played was happening on the spot, even though it might have…
Can we get that out there, Brad?
